name: Elias
source:
A boy whose arms are mixed with a strange curse due to the play of the goddess.

He's mature for his age but his mother, Elizabeth, is missing, and he seems to always be worried.

"I'm... more honest and serious than you guys."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
